risks.if_unproven: priced as old/aged stock, lower end

risks.risk: Hidden internal damage, patches, or sidewall bulges not visible in current angles
risks.proof: Close-up of full sidewall circumference and inner tire surface
risks.if_unproven: priced as possibly repaired/damaged, worst case

risks.risk: Actual tread depth not verifiable from photos alone
risks.proof: Photo with a tread-depth gauge or coin inserted in groove

risks.risk: Mismatched tires (different sizes/brands) sold as a set
